mechanism_claims.claim_text: NFAP2 membrane-disruption evidence is supported by propidium iodide staining of C. albicans cells after treatment with nNFAP2 and selected active fragments at MIC.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: nNFAP2, Fr-2, Fr-3, Fr-4, Sh-Fr-2, Sh-Fr-4
mechanism_claims.limitations: The local source supports membrane permeabilization in C. albicans under the reported short exposure assay; it does not prove a complete cellular target pathway.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Functional mapping places the active region in the mid-N-terminal NNCKHKKGSGC-containing fragment rather than the C-terminal gamma-core fragment.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: NFAP2 fragments Fr-2/Fr-4 and shuffled variants
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is source-backed structure-activity interpretation, not a direct binding-site assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The source supports heat-stable/folded recombinant and synthetic NFAP2 forms and structural comparability by mass, RP-HPLC, ECD, and NMR-oriented assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biophysical similarity supports interpretation of activity comparisons but is not a separate antimicrobial mechanism.
